_about: The barbershop bench fixture (2026-09-04). A made-up two-chair shop: five services with prices and durations, one testimonial, four phone photos, booking on, no logo, no brand colors. The photo urls do not resolve; `shoot` swaps in labeled stand-ins.
owner_brief: I need a website for my barbershop. Marrow & Steel Barber Co in Lakewood. It's me and one other barber, two chairs, walk-ins and appointments. We do classic cuts, skin fades, beard work, and hot towel shaves. I've been cutting 14 years, opened this shop in 2021. I want it to feel like a real shop, not a salon. Dark, clean, a little old-school but not a costume. Guys should be able to book from the site. I don't want it to look like every other barbershop website with the crossed razors and the barber pole. Show the work. We're good at fades and beard lineups and I want that to be obvious. Price list on the site, people always ask.

offerings.name: Classic Cut
offerings.description: Scissor or clipper cut, shaped to your head and your habits. Neck cleanup and a finish.

offerings.name: Skin Fade
offerings.description: Down to skin, blended tight, lined up sharp. Low, mid, or high.

offerings.name: Beard Trim & Lineup
offerings.description: Shaped, edged, and lined. Hot towel and oil to finish.

offerings.name: Hot Towel Shave
offerings.description: Straight razor, two hot towels, lather, and a cold finish.

offerings.name: The Full Works
offerings.description: Cut, beard, and hot towel shave in one sitting.
